rules.title: How to Play Jambo
rules.objectiveText: Win rounds by playing the highest card of the leading suit. The winner of the last round wins the game.
rules.setupText1: In solo, 4 players per game (you + 3 bots), in multiplayer, between 2 and 4
rules.setupText3: In solo, 10 credits bet per game, in multiplayer, up to half your balance
rules.turnFlowText1: The first player chooses any card from their hand and leads the round.
rules.turnFlowText2: Going clockwise, each other player must play a card of the same suit if they have one.
rules.turnFlowText3: If a player cannot follow suit, they may play any card.
rules.turnFlowText4: Once all 4 players have played, the round ends.
rules.winningRoundText1: The highest card of the leading suit wins the round.
rules.winningRoundText2: Cards that do not follow the leading suit cannot win.
rules.winningRoundText3: The round winner leads the next round.
rules.koraText: If the winning card of the last round is a 3 (the lowest rank), it triggers a Kora:
rules.koraText1: The bet collected from losers is double the initial bet (e.g.: initial bet = 10, collected bet 20 credits per player).
rules.koraText2: The winner receives the bets collected from other players.
rules.doubleKoraText: If the last round (round 5) ends with a KORA and the same player also won the previous round (round 4) with a 3, it triggers a Double Kora:
rules.doubleKoraText1: The bet collected from losers is quadrupled.
rules.doubleKoraText2: The winner receives the bets collected from other players.
rules.gameEndText1: The game ends after all 5 rounds have been played.
rules.gameEndText2: The player who won the last round wins the game.
rules.gameEndText3: Depending on the cards played during the last two rounds, the winnings vary.
rules.gameLeaveText: If a player exits a game (solo or multiplayer) while connected, they have a 30-minute grace period before being ejected
rules.gameLeaveText1: After 15 minutes, they will receive an email notifying them to return to the started game
rules.gameLeaveText2: After 30 minutes, they are ejected from the game and lose their bet, which will be awarded to the winner of the abandoned game
rules.gameLeaveText3: If a player remains the only one connected to the game, it ends and the other players' bets are awarded to them
